HiveMQ Broker Writing

HiveMQ is an MQTT broker that provides community and enterprise editions. HiveMQ is mainly for enterprise emerging machine-to-machine M2M communication and internal transport, meeting scalability, ease of management, and security features. HiveMQ provides an open-source plug-in development kit. MQTT data can be saved to TDengine via TDengine extension for HiveMQ. For more information, see HiveMQ TDengine Extension.
